name: Blueville Acres Blueberry Farm
description: Blueville Acres Blueberry Farm is an agritourism farm in 093 Judd Rd, MI, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
